added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite arms in its manifest.md: base failure ids and head failure ids are both 11 for tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py and differ by exactly one row, head-only test_tangent_compiles_within_bound[second_residual] against base-only test_tangent_compiles_within_bound[channel_split]. The vertex arms exist only as test_logs entries; comparing gate/base-test_vertex_term_tangents.log and gate/head-test_vertex_term_tangents.log gives 5 identical failure ids in both arms and adds none. Fifteen of the sixteen edge-arm failures are the 300 s pytest-timeout bound on compile-bound rows in both arms.

findings.text: xp.where(near, _weighted_root(self, term), reduced) evaluates the graded quadrature for every target before selecting the near band, so nothing confines the near-band quadrature to the targets that select it; this is the goal verbatim and it is untouched by the diff, yet the run is recorded complete, and the shipped arm fails its own throughput assertion at scripts/prototypes/polygon_near_band/measure.py:411 (98.4359 ms against a 93.185 ms bound), which the manifest attributes to the unchanged selection rather than to a regression.

the edge JVP identity rows test_tangent_matches_base_jvp[edge_integrands|flux_and_moment_terms|edge_terms] and test_truncated_tangent_fails_identity[...] raise Failed: Timeout (>300.0s) in both arms, so the done_when clause that the five JVP identities still hold at 1e-9 is not evidenced by this gate; the landing record asserts it as fact while the only logs that could show it stopped at the pytest-timeout bound.

the artifacts field cites gate/compare-after.json for the CPU before/after walls, but that file does not exist in the run directory; only gate/compare-after-job-1307534.log does, so a reader following the citation finds nothing and the recorded THROUGHPUT line has no JSON receipt behind it.

baseline_suite and after_suite each record a single command over tests/biot/test_edge_term_tangents.py only, while the evidence fence names tests/biot/test_vertex_term_tangents.py as well; the vertex arms exist only as test_logs entries, so the armed receipt covers half the stated gate, and the vertex file's own revision is not recorded in either JSON.

the done_when asks for the wall tabled before and after on both the H200 and CPU, and the run directory holds no H200, titan or betelgeuse allocation at all: every wall recorded (branch-share-cpu.json, gate/compare-after-job-1307534.log) is device cpu:0, the brief's scripts/nova_lane/run.sh --rungs h200,titan recipe was never invoked, and the manifest's own evidence_inputs concedes no compaction arm was run on H200, so the device half of the measure is unmeasured rather than measured and equal.

the negative control is recorded as non-discriminating in the manifest's own words: the unmutated shipped arm fails the same throughput assertion (98.4359 ms against a 93.185 ms bound) that the forced-full mutation fails, so the control shows the assertion fires but not that it fires on the mutation, and the node has no red log that a passing arm would have produced.
